notes: The model keeps RFC_5322.Date (no public API change); only the Codable form changes. Encoding writes RFC 3339 with the date's own offset (Z for UTC, +hh:mm otherwise; an offset beyond ±23:59 falls back to the UTC instant). Decoding requires RFC 3339 and throws DecodingError.dataCorrupted otherwise; fractional seconds are dropped because RFC_5322.DateTime holds whole seconds. Package.swift: new dependency https://github.com/swift-ietf/swift-rfc-3339.git (branch main) and product 'RFC 3339' on the 'JSON Feed Foundation Integration' target; swift-ietf/swift-rfc-3339 is in repos.txt. Tests: decode of the JSON Feed spec's example date 2010-02-07T14:04:00-05:00, encode of UTC and +01:00 dates, rejection of an RFC 5322 date string. Uses Gregorian.DateTime(secondsSinceEpoch:) and .secondsSinceEpoch via RFC_3339's @_exported Calendar_Gregorian. No other package uses JSONFeed.
